_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
v3.2.126

SysID comparison now requires two scans to agree across their overlapping measured duties. Finishing both scans and passing each scan's internal checks no longer implies repeatability. Reports preserve the original curves, prediction tolerances and failed duties, with measurement coverage reported separately.

Validation: cross-scan shift/gain/symmetry regressions plus existing matched-probe and snapshot tests on both branches. Firmware, PID, calibration and saved tuning are unchanged. Experimental controller firmware is withheld; wrist/Omron and fleet qualification remain open.
